name: Chest Wall Detection in Digital Mammography Benchmark
description: A dataset and evaluation protocol for assessing algorithms that detect the chest wall boundary in digital mammograms.
evaluation_method: boundary distance metrics (mean boundary error) and overlap metrics (Dice / IoU) with F1 for boundary detection
general_score_metric: mean boundary error (and Dice / IoU for overlap)
reputation: Niche medical-imaging benchmark used in mammography research for chest-wall boundary localization; moderate adoption within specialized communities.
notes: Medical-imaging dataset with annotation variability and privacy/regulatory considerations; often small/moderate dataset sizes; non-LLM benchmark. Performance can be sensitive to imaging device and population differences.
